title: Demand Service Rate Programs: Step for the Owner's Other Accounts on an Arrears Fee
content:
Where the owner holds an active preventive maintenance agreement and the installments that fell due on
it in the same window are not cleared by the payments received on it, a step of 0.5 percent is added to
the monthly rate. Where the owner holds an active preventive maintenance agreement and the installments
that fell due on it in that window are cleared, a step of 0.25 percent is taken off the monthly rate. In
any other case no step for the owner's other accounts touches the monthly rate.

The agreement and its standing are read from the customer's Preventive Maintenance Agreements records;
the installments that fell due on that agreement and the payments received on it are read over the same window as the demand service fee raised on the rate program held under the Demand Service Rate Programs, the 12 months to the day the fee is raised.

| The owner's Preventive Maintenance Agreements standing | The agreement's installments against its payments in the window | The step on the monthly rate |
|---|---|---|
| an active agreement | the payments do not clear the installments | 0.5 percent added |
| an active agreement | the payments clear the installments | 0.25 percent taken off |
| no active agreement | any | no step touches the monthly rate |

**Illustration (hypothetical).** An owner holding an active preventive maintenance agreement on which
9000 US dollars of installments fell due in the window and 9000 US dollars of payments were received
carries the 0.25 percent step off the rate, the payments clearing the installments; had 7500 US dollars
been received, the 0.5 percent step would be added instead.
